title: Why You Can't Divide by Zero

steps.body: Dividing by zero has no answer at all — it is undefined, not zero.
steps.narration: Dividing by zero has no answer at all — it is undefined, not zero.

widget.prompt: Count the squares in this 4 by 6 array.

commonCounts.feedback: That adds 4 and 6 instead of counting every square.
That counts one row of the four.

widget.lowFeedback: Keep counting — every square in all 4 rows belongs to the total.
widget.highFeedback: The grid holds only 24 squares; counting past that means a square was counted twice.

predict.reveal: Division asks what times the divisor gives the total. Since anything × 0 = 0, nothing × 0 can give 7.

explanationVariants: Nothing multiplied by 0 gives a nonzero total.
Division by zero has no answer at all.

options.feedback: If 7 ÷ 0 were 7, then 7 × 0 would have to equal 7, but 7 × 0 = 0.
If 7 ÷ 0 were 1, then 1 × 0 would have to equal 7, but 1 × 0 = 0.

options.label: Undefined — division by zero has no answer
options.feedback: Correct — no number multiplied by 0 gives 7, so the division has no answer.
If 7 ÷ 0 were 0, then 0 × 0 would have to equal 7, but 0 × 0 = 0.

commonErrors.feedback: That repeats the divisor. Sharing nothing among 5 groups leaves nothing in each.
Zero shared into 5 groups gives 0 in each group, not 1.

widget.successFeedback: Correct — 0 ÷ 5 = 0. Zero as the TOTAL is fine; only zero as the DIVISOR is undefined.
